# Juice Kitchen

> Juice Kitchen is a family-owned juice café in Coral Springs, FL, serving organic smoothies, açaí bowls, fresh-pressed juices, specialty coffee, and toasts, all made fresh to order for pickup or delivery.

Juice Kitchen is a neighborhood café in Coral Springs, Florida. Everything is made fresh to order with organic ingredients. The menu covers smoothies, açaí and pitaya bowls, cold-pressed juices, coffee (espresso, cold brew, and chagaccino), toasts, and light bites. Online ordering is available for pickup and local delivery.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://juicekitchencafe.com/): Overview of Juice Kitchen, featured items, and quick links to order.
- [Menu](https://juicekitchencafe.com/#menu): Full menu of smoothies, açaí bowls, juices, coffee, and toasts.
- [Order Online](https://juicekitchencafe.com/#order): Place a pickup or delivery order.
- [About](https://juicekitchencafe.com/#about): The family-owned story behind the café.
- [Location](https://juicekitchencafe.com/#location): Location, hours, phone, and directions.
